A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "Beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>Alpha</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
